Demonstration / reference data This Studio view intentionally separates working software readiness from scientific release readiness. Synthetic/demo assets remain useful for testing UI and pipelines, but real imported evidence is required before publication-grade claims.

🧪 Applied biotechnology projects

BIO-PPI-ML 🔗 Protein Interaction ML Engineer sequence-derived pair features, train leakage-aware classifiers, compare algorithms and score candidate protein interactions with calibrated research outputs.

BIO-CG-PATH 🧫 Comparative Pathogen Genomics Compare assembled genomes or contigs against a controlled reference panel, quantify k-mer similarity and genomic composition, and screen configurable characterization markers.

BIO-SCRNA 🧬 Single-Cell Heterogeneity Perform cell-level quality control, normalization, highly-variable-gene selection, dimensionality reduction, clustering and marker-gene screening on scRNA-seq count matrices.

BIO-CANCER-GX 🎗️ Cancer Genomics Prioritize somatic variants, summarize tumor mutational burden, inspect variant allele fractions, map altered genes to pathways and produce a transparent research-only evidence table.

BIO-META-PIPE 🦠 Metagenomics Pipeline Run a reproducible abundance-table workflow covering quality checks, prevalence filtering, normalization, alpha/beta diversity, ordination and group-aware differential abundance screening.
